After reload it waits for both visible "Comment deleted" tombstones before taking the exact chronological DOM inventory. Opening Comments mounts an asynchronous read; a separate API snapshot does not establish that the panel has rendered. Existing author/refusal, timestamp, replay and exact order assertions remain required, with unchanged timeouts and CI registrations.
